scope: Current-product foundation bootstrap command sequencing and environment-file preservation

environment.fixtures: Disposable temporary projects; node/pnpm/docker commands stubbed; no database, model or external action invoked

cases.precondition: Migration and current-product seed stubs succeed; environment file absent
cases.steps: Run bash scripts/bootstrap.sh --skip-computer in an isolated project
cases.expected: db:migrate precedes exactly one db:seed; no compatibility seed; environment copied; exit 0
cases.actual: Passed; command log equals -v, db:migrate, db:seed; environment equals fixture example

cases.steps: Run the same bootstrap with injected migration failure
cases.expected: No seed command; explicit skip message; overall exit 1
cases.actual: Passed after guard; original committed script invokes db:seed and fails the regression

cases.steps: Run bootstrap with injected seed failure
cases.expected: Seed failure recorded as blocking; no successful-seed message; exit 1
cases.actual: Passed; command log keeps migration before seed and summary has FAIL=1

cases.precondition: Existing environment file has different contents from example
cases.steps: Run bootstrap with successful command stubs
cases.expected: Existing environment content remains byte-for-byte intact
cases.actual: Passed; existing live/store text retained and skip message present
